title: Add progression state + auditable progression-event ledger
description: Extend the SQLite live-state store (state/party.ts, mutateState.ts, liveStateSchema.ts) with durable progression state: current XP, advancement mode, and a progression_events ledger of awards and level-up applications. Each ledger row is an append-only auditable record (kind, amount/milestone, source, resulting level/XP, timestamp). No mechanics yet — just durable, validated state.
acceptance_criteria: Schema migration adds XP + advancement-mode to character state and a progression_events table; reads/writes go through validated state helpers; round-trip tests cover persistence and validation.
notes: PR: https://github.com/jbongaarts/eshyra/pull/335 (open, ready for review). Bead stays in_progress until merge.
close_reason: Merged via PR #335. Durable progression state (character.current_xp), campaign_progression_policy singleton, and append-only progression_event ledger with fail-closed per-kind validation. Migration 0003.
